explore.title: Explore
explore.capped: Showing the first {{count}} — zoom in to see more
explore.error: Couldn't load places. Check your connection.
explore.empty: No places here yet. Zoom out or move the map.
explore.locationDenied: Location is off. Places still work — just move the map.
explore.mapLabel: Map. The list below shows what's on the map.

venue.notFound: This place isn't listed any more.

saved.title: Saved
saved.empty: Places you save appear here. They're stored only on this device.

help.title: Help
help.intro: LGBTQIA+ crisis and support lines for where you are. Tap to call or message.
help.mayContactPolice: This service says it may contact police or emergency services without your consent.
help.noContactPolice: This service says it does not contact police without your consent.
help.emergency: In immediate danger, call your local emergency number.
help.error: Couldn't load support lines. If you need help now, call your local emergency number.
help.empty: No listed lines for your region yet.

me.title: Me
me.privacyBody: This app has no analytics or tracking. Your location is used only on this device. Saved places never leave it.

discreet.title: Discreet mode
discreet.intro: Tools for using this app on a phone someone else might see. Everything here stays on this device.
discreet.lockHint: Ask for Face ID, fingerprint or your passcode to open the app.
discreet.lockUnavailable: Set a passcode on this device to use the app lock.
discreet.hideInSwitcherIos: Blurs the app's preview when you switch apps.
discreet.hideInSwitcherAndroid: Shows a blank preview when you switch apps. This also blocks screenshots.
discreet.quickExitHint: Adds an Exit button that clears the app and shows a blank notes page. Long-press the date to come back.
discreet.iconHintIos: Only the icon changes: the name under it stays the same.
discreet.iconHintAndroid: Your launcher may take a moment to show the new icon.
discreet.iconError: Couldn't change the icon. Try again.

packs.title: Offline cities
packs.body: Download a city to keep its places and crisis lines on this device. Map tiles and photos still need a connection.
packs.notConfigured: Offline cities aren't available in this build yet.
packs.verifyFailed: This download didn't pass its security check and was not saved.
packs.discreetNote: Downloaded cities are listed on this device. Remove them before handing your phone to someone.

search.title: Search
search.offline: Search needs a connection. Download a city under Me → Offline cities to search it offline.
search.fromPacks: Offline — showing results from your downloaded cities.

auth.consentLabel: I agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy, confirm I am 18 or older, and understand queer.guide is an 18+ platform that includes dating and intimate features.
auth.consentRequired: Accept the terms and confirm you are 18 or older to create an account.
auth.forgot: Forgot password? Reset it on the web

errors.alreadyRegistered: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.captcha: Sign-in needs a verification step the app can't show yet. Use queer.guide on the web for now.
errors.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.

account.title: Account
account.signedOutBody: You don't need an account to browse. Signing in shows places you're allowed to see in countries where they are hidden from visitors, and keeps your account the same as on the web.
account.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your queer.guide account and everything stored with it, on every device. It can't be undone.
account.deleteLocal: Places saved only on this phone and downloaded cities stay until you remove them.
account.deleteFailed: Your account couldn't be deleted. Try again, or contact support if it keeps failing.
account.loadError: Couldn't load your account. Check your connection.

events.error: Couldn't load this event. Check your connection.
events.notFound: This event isn't listed any more.
events.empty: No upcoming events here. Zoom out or move the map.

push.title: Notifications
push.body: Off unless you turn it on. Signing out removes this phone, so the next person to sign in here never gets your notifications. Nothing is sent yet.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked in system settings. Tap to open Settings.
push.unavailable: Notifications aren't available on this device or build.
push.failed: Couldn't change this. Check your connection and try again.
